name: comp-583
blurb: Breadcrumb header with dropdown project selector.
description: Header showing breadcrumb navigation with account/project hierarchy. Project selector is a dropdown menu. Notification and user menus included.
use_when: Multi-tenant or project-based apps showing user location in hierarchy with quick project switching.
avoid_when: Linear navigation; breadcrumbs are better for deep hierarchies.
a11y: Breadcrumb items are navigable. Project selector has aria-label. Mobile menu collapses at breakpoint.
